subject: Security & compliance follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & compliance follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, roadmap

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation with you and the EnterpriseCorp security group. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Current state: you mentioned EnterpriseCorp requires SOC 2 Type II for primary vendors and has GDPR obligations for EU customers; HIPAA applies to specific product lines.
- Redwood status: we have SOC 2 Type II in progress (controls mapped, auditor engaged; expected report Q1 2027). We support GDPR controls (data residency, DSAR process) and have an optional HIPAA addendum for covered workloads.
- Immediate asks we noted from your team: copy of SOC2 scope summary, answers to vendor security questionnaire, and timeline for SOC scope expansion to cover dedicated/private deployments.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (high-level scope/status). I also attached a Vendor_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx — if you prefer, we can complete your native questionnaire instead.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share the SOC2 summary and our questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow.
2) Rishi (cc) will schedule a follow-up technical call next week to review encryption, key management (KMS/HSM), and network controls.
3) Lauren (cc) can walk through our compliance roadmap (ISO 27001 evaluation, SOC scope expansion, and FedRAMP exploratory conversations) on the call if helpful.

Do these steps work for you? If there are other stakeholders who should be looped in, please let me know.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132

---
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
Attachment: Vendor_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@enterprisecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-team@enterprisecorp.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, roadmap

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: good to hear you have Type II in progress. For procurement we need a SOC2 summary now and a plan for achieving full coverage for dedicated/private instances (this is a blocker for our Dedicated pilot).
- GDPR: please confirm whether you support EU data residency for model artifacts and logs. We will need data processing terms for our DSAR process.
- HIPAA: we'll confirm with legal which product lines fall under PHI scope and share the questionnaire accordingly.

Request: can you pre-fill the attached Vendor_Questionnaire_Template with answers about encryption in transit at rest, KMS/HSM, employee background checks, vulnerability testing cadence, and incident response SLA? That will save our security team time.

Also cc'ing our security ops alias (security-team@enterprisecorp.com) — they'll validate the questionnaire fields. Looking forward to the technical call; next week Tue/Wed morning PT works for us.

Best,
Alex
Head of Cloud Architecture | EnterpriseCorp
alex.johnson@enterprisecorp.com

Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA, roadmap

Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply. I'll take the lead on the technical questionnaire. Plan: I'll pre-fill the Vendor_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx with answers to the sections you called out (encryption in transit/at rest, KMS/HSM, employee access controls, pentest cadence, IR SLA), then attach our relevant control references and evidence links. Expect that by EOD Wednesday.

A couple clarifications that would help:
- EU data residency: we currently offer region-specific hosting for customer data in AWS eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 for Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments — is that sufficient or do you require on-prem?
- SOC scope expansion: our roadmap includes widening the SOC boundary to cover Dedicated pools and Private (customer-managed) deployments; target start Q4 2026 with auditor scoping in early Q1 2027. If EnterpriseCorp has a target date, share it and we'll prioritize.

I'll also include a short section on our ISO 27001 evaluation work and where FedRAMP exploratory conversations sit (we've had vendor readiness calls with a FedRAMP consultant; formal program TBD based on customer demand).

Talk soon — I'll send the pre-filled questionnaire by EOD.

—Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
